error: one standard deviation; source substitutes the record mean uncertainty where individual errors were unavailable
ageBasis: Published gas ages, calendar years BP1950; AICC2012 except the constituent recent Law Dome, WAIS and Siple Dome records. Not ice ages.
selection: Nearest actual sample, with its own gas age visible; no interpolation or extrapolation. Application scope: prehistoric consultation through10001BCE; later published records retain precedence.
